rules: Complete source review and approved release before the existing 2026-10-18T10:35:15Z expiry; this draft extends nothing in production.
Candidate/link expiry is fixed at 30 days after this source check, not 30 days after an eventual signature.
If release preparation occurs more than 24 hours after this check, recheck all official identities and 15 destinations; changes require a new candidate/hash and approval.
Any changed identity, unexplained destination redirect, removed official backlink, revoked link or missing source suspends the affected proposal until resolved; no automatic expiry extension.
Re-read latest production index before preparing a release, retaining all non-organizations modules byte-for-byte in their descriptors.
Neutral logos do not block verified links. A later non-null logo requires exact PNG/JPEG, documented use basis, hash/media validation, and both native capability proofs.
Native runtime still requires authenticated current content and a new payment-session freshness check before opening donation; content expiry and link expiry are hard boundaries.
Manual review date is a proposed editorial deadline, not a newly scheduled automation.
